title: Tenma Saki — Happy Birthday!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Just two more weeks until my birthday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've gotten to do so much since starting high school too, like playing in shows and writing my own music.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I even got to go to the Seaside School and do a shrine visit with everyone during New Year's.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I never imagined being able to have fun every day like this...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I guess I have Mom, Dad, Tsukasa, the girls, Miku and everyone else to thank since they're always there for me.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I want to thank them all somehow.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm... What would work best?
Ideally, something that lets everyone know how much I appreciate them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I know!
bgm_area00001
Saki's Birthday
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, let's get everything for our surprise party set up before Saki and the others get here.

rows.Speaker: Rin, Len & MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, hold on...
I think someone just arrived in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Good morning♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: S-Sakki?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(Len, hide that box of decorations!
I'll deal with these!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (O-Okay!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Good call, you two!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What's up, you guys?
Why are you all looking at me like that?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, nothing. We're just surprised that you're here so early this morning.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
There's actually something I want to give all of you!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Give us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! Ta-daa!
A certificate of appreciation from me♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, that's...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
First... Ahem...
Thank you, Ms. Miku!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ms. Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I really appreciate how you're always there to practice together, give me advice, cheer me up and support me when I really need it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're the reason why I've been able to do so much with the girls and our band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can never ever thank you enough for what you've done, so I would like to present you with this certificate of appreciation stamped with the Tenma seal♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: May 9th, from Saki Tenma, who is enjoying a very happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can really have this?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course! Oh, I have one for each of you too! Lemme go around in order!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sakki, you must've put so much effort into these! I really like all the cute pegasuses you drew!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. You know how some fancy certificates have shiny borders with phoenixes on them? I thought I'd do that but with pegasuses instead.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, that's what you meant by the Tenma seal!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We get to have something this adorable... Thank you, Saki. We couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you guys.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're all the reason why I was able to celebrate a happy birthday with Ichi and the girls!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I promise to keep doing my best this upcoming year, so I hope you'll keep watching over us!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Of course...
Let's all do our best, together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Good morning...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, Saki.
What's up?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Is right now a good time? There's something I'd like to give all of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure. We just wrapped up our morning practice, so we should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's actually my birthday today, and I'd like to present all of you with certificates of appreciation for helping me get through this past year!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: C-Certificates of appreciation?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes! First...
Thank you, Ms. Airi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: As an idol, past and present, you've been a massive source of encouragement and hope for me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You even went out of your way to help me bake a cake and plan a surprise for Valentine's Day!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I present you with this certificate of appreciation stamped with the Tenma seal! From Saki Tenma, who promises to be your fan forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Y-You really got me there...
I don't know what to say... I'm so happy that you made my heart jump.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Good for you, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thank you for this, Saki.
And happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I have one for all of you, so I'll go around in order♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Including me?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Especially considering how much I get to hang out with Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! I've never received a certificate of appreciation like this before!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, this is the perfect opportunity to give you your birthday present... Oh no! I left my bag in class...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I left mine in class too, so why don't we head over together later?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'd like to join you if you don't mind.
I mean, she deserves a proper celebration.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to do that as well♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You mean it?!
Yay! I can't wait!
Corridor

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm glad I got a chance to give Airi and the others their certificates.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll get to Ichi and the girls during lunch, so that just leaves Kohane, Emu and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, perfect! You're both here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa! I got a certificate of appreciation!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you, Saki!
This is so wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I need to really thank you both for hanging out and being friends with me!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But these are handmade, right?!
Are you giving these to Shiho and the others as well?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, during lunch! I really wanna surprise them, so let's keep this between us for now♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa's gonna get his later tonight, so please keep that a secret too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Roger!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Alright, Ichi and the girls are my last targets at school! I've gotta really show them just how much I appreciate them♪)
